scope: Phase 2B2 optional literal title constraints; historical native evidence retains its original binary/platform.

matching.optionalPerCategory: Disabled by default; only KeepMatching audio/subtitles use the constraint.
matching.predicate: Known exact canonical language AND actual inspected Title contains trimmed literal search text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase.
matching.titleBoundaries: All matches retained in original order. Missing/blank titles do not match; no filename, codec, UI fallback, normalization, regex or wildcard matching. Enabled blank searches are invalid.
matching.languageSafety: Every targeted track language is validated even if its title does not match. Unknown/conflicting metadata or no combined audio matches leaves the whole file unchanged for manual review. Silent inputs remain valid; no subtitle matches explicitly proposes none.
matching.lifecycle: Read-only issued/revision-bound Preview; explicit Apply; changed-only approval/Review invalidation. No automatic application, approval, exclusion or Run. Language switches preserve valid proposals; New batch clears them.

localChecks.requiredMediaSetting: TRACKTRIM_REQUIRE_MEDIA_TOOLS=1; explicit acquired-tools-with-source and generated fixture directories

realBackend.method: Pinned tool creates tiny original VP8/PCM/SRT title variants with reordered tracks; production Preview/Apply derives selections before explicit approval/Review and the existing queue. Both outputs independently pass backend metadata/XML/attachment-metadata/timestamp checks. Four nonempty extracted VP8/PCM payload representations are SHA256-compared by MediaPayloadEvidence; individual payload digests are not emitted. This is integration, not native GUI evidence.
